title: Black Bean Turkish Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew made with black beans, turkey, and a hint of Turkish spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the ground turkey and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the onion soup mix and cook for 1 minute.
Add the red pepper flakes and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth, tomato paste, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the black beans and stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
